student_learning_goal: I can analyse a bar graph and write a conclusion using mode.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can analyse a bar graph and write a conclusion using mode.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot and Tally in detective hats in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 2 questions. Survey 6 classmates. Tally in a 2-way table.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 2x2 tally table for a Grade 2 capstone worksheet. Top: 'My questions: ___'. 4 cells for tallying.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_TALLY at Part 1: instructions ask the child to tally 2-way. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any valid 2-question survey of 6 with tallies in correct cells.

parts.student_instructions: Build a bar graph from your tally. Find the MODE.
parts.visual_layout: Blank bar graph grid + mode line.

image_placeholders.description: A blank bar graph grid + mode line for a Grade 2 capstone worksheet. Grid ~5in × 3in with empty axes. Below: 'The MODE is: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_BAR at Part 2: instructions ask the child to build a bar graph and find mode. Keywords name the activities.

parts.answer_key: Bar graph from tally totals + correct mode (most common value).

parts.student_instructions: Write a conclusion using the mode.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered writing box for a Grade 2 capstone worksheet, ~5in × 1.5in. Above: 'My conclusion:'. Below the box, sentence-frame reminder: 'The mode is ___. Most children chose ___.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_CONCLUSION at Part 3: instructions ask the child to write a conclusion. Keywords name the focus.

parts.answer_key: Any conclusion using GROUP language and MODE. Sample: 'The mode is hockey. Most children in our class chose hockey.'

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a comparison: 'More chose ___ than ___.'
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone — score against the rubric. Look for: 2-question survey (D1.2), bar graph with title and labels (D1.3), correct mode (D1.4), data-based conclusion (D1.5).
